checks.reason: Codex's evidence does not show jumps at Trieben. The ÖAeC register (issued 3 Feb 2026) only records that Internationaler Pink Parachute Club holds a school authorisation with LOGI as its training site, and no Pink Skyvan schedule from Jan 2025 to Nov 2026 lists Trieben (13 archived versions checked, plus the live page). The jumps are run by Airgasmo, the airfield's listed parachute operator in 2024. That is weekend operation in season, which AT.json records as seasonal; the recorded coordinates are within about 50 m of the OSM aerodrome.

checks.reason: Airgasmo's 'Lienz' is this airfield: the 'Flugplatz Lienz' pin on its own dropzone map (46.80032, 12.87523) lies inside the OSM outline of LOKL, and its Lienz ticket is listed at 'lienz-nikolsdorf', location Lengberg, the airfield's postal address. Its 2026 schedule, a published season calendar that the README accepts, lists jumps there on 27–28 Jun and 12–13 Sep 2026; take-off is the 500 m runway 12/30 and the AIP lists parachuting as an admitted activity. No source states the landing area, and I found no post, review or airfield notice showing either weekend took place: the Lienz ticket has 0 reviews (Airgasmo's Trieben ticket has 132) and the airfield site does not mention parachuting, so this is a two-weekend site whose seasonal status rests on the schedule alone. The recorded operator (Fallschirmzentrum Kärnten) no longer lists the site, and the coordinates match the AIP reference point within about 30 m.
